ideas.pitch: A CLI and web interface designed to rapidly compile, format, and structure professional bug bounty reports for Cyberhunt 2077 scenarios.
ideas.problem_statement: Cyberhunt 2077: Investigate scenarios, identify vulnerabilities, and write up professional bug reports covering overview, root cause, mechanism, attack path, impact, and proof of concept.
ideas.title: SecReportGen
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the specific judging weightage on comprehensive and accurate documentation by minimizing friction in structuring professional security disclosures under time constraints.

ideas.pitch: An automated triage assistant that analyzes target source snippets and configuration files to flag high-probability injection points and broken authorization logic.
ideas.problem_statement: Cyberhunt 2077: You'll receive a set of scenarios/targets: vulnerable apps, code snippets, configs, or system descriptions to investigate.
ideas.title: VulnerableTargetTriage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the solo time-crunch bottleneck by accelerating code snippet and configuration auditing during a rapid 24-48 hour challenge.

ideas.pitch: A reproducible payload and PoC sandbox manager that helps solo security hunters capture screenshots, cURL commands, and execution steps seamlessly.
ideas.problem_statement: Cyberhunt 2077: Submit a bug report including proof of concept with screenshots, payloads, or code that back up each claim.
ideas.title: ProofForge
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the grading weight placed on reproducibility and concrete evidence in security write-ups.

ideas.pitch: A specialized node graph visualizer mapping out access control matrices and authorization logic from target app descriptions to spot privilege escalation paths.
ideas.problem_statement: Cyberhunt 2077: Identify vulnerabilities such as broken authorization or injection, detailing the underlying flaw and where it sits in the logic.
ideas.title: AuthFlawMapper
ideas.why_it_could_win: Offers a clear visual advantage in tracing complex authorization logic flaws, aligning directly with the core root-cause analysis requirements.

ideas.pitch: A centralized dashboard for solo participants to track target investigation status, notes, submission timers, and report validation checklists.
ideas.problem_statement: Cyberhunt 2077: Investigate each scenario, identify the vulnerability, work out its real impact, and submit a bug report for each finding through the platform.
ideas.title: BountyTracker 2077
ideas.why_it_could_win: Maximizes efficiency for solo participants facing multiple concurrent security scenarios within a strict 24-48 hour timeframe.
